title: Lagrangian endpoint pricing with best-of-k measured moves and a ratcheting WNS floor in the post-stock TNS-recovery phase
hypothesis: The champion's post-stock recovery (runTnsRecovery) ranks drivers with a memoryless shared-driver score and accepts the first improving move against a fixed stock-WNS floor, so it saturates on Ibex's fanout-943 driver, rarely reaches JPEG's independent deep arithmetic cones, and gives back WNS (iterations 14, 15). Replace it with a multiplicative-weights Lagrangian loop: each violating endpoint carries a price lambda_e that grows while it stays violated, drivers are ranked by the lambda-weighted sum over their deduplicated downstream endpoints, and each chosen driver gets best-of-k measured evaluation across the existing size/swap/clone/split generators from one journal checkpoint. Commits must satisfy a ratcheting WNS floor max(stock-final, best-so-far) and a per-endpoint veto protecting high-price endpoints. The stock loop stays byte-identical; a 600-trial or 6-round budget bounds runtime, avoiding iteration 8's timeout.

evaluator.lesson: Multiplicative endpoint prices retained Ibex's shared-driver bias and worsened TNS magnitude by 28.53% versus champion; isolate cone diversity and structural move coverage before retuning prices.
evaluator.dead_end: Do not repeat the bundled lambda-sum recovery replacement with only higher price growth or larger search budgets.
good_changes: src/rsz/src/policy/SetupLegacyPolicy.cc: measured alternatives selected later moves on 17 of 57 JPEG commits; JPEG TNS improved 0.513403 ns versus champion, although causal contribution is not isolated.
src/rsz/src/policy/SetupLegacyPolicy.cc: six-round/600-trial bounds completed all four measured runs.
bad_changes: src/rsz/src/policy/SetupLegacyPolicy.cc: lambda-sum ranking over 400 paths and 50 drivers changed Ibex ordering in only one of six rounds.
src/rsz/src/policy/SetupLegacyPolicy.cc: fixed 16-endpoint veto excludes most endpoints and initially nonviolating outputs.
src/rsz/src/policy/SetupLegacyPolicy.cc: best-of-three move types does not ensure clone/split/buffer coverage.
